dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shouldn't you go take a break first?

dialogues.speaker: Eliseev
dialogues.text: Ah... that won't... solve this problem, dear customer.

dialogues.speaker: Eliseev
dialogues.text: Shifts in the weather cause different responses in different Volkodlak... Not like how it goes with you humans...

dialogues.speaker: Eliseev
dialogues.text: For me... I get sleepier than usual...
